g.text: Front9 — how the agent builds a project
One prompt in. Three agents cooperate: the Planner designs the app, the Architect cuts it into file-level tasks, and the Coder writes each file
through sandboxed tools — then the graph outputs a runnable project.
A single natural-language request, hardcoded in agents/graph.py — e.g. "a calculator
web app with basic arithmetic and a clean UI"
Loaded from .env with python-dotenv. It is the only secret the pipeline needs.
path + purpose — one entry per file the
Solid arrow — the main path of a run, one step to the next.
Dashed arrow — this step reads/writes the state or calls a tool.
Diamond — the loop decision. Glass sheet — a group of helpers.
Colour carries no meaning; every shape is a stage or a supporting part.
EXAMPLE RUN — the calculator in generated_project/
prompt "a calculator web app with basic arithmetic and good UI"
Plan name + tech_stack + features[] + files[] (index.html, styles.css, app.js)
TaskPlan one or more implementation steps per file, dependencies first
Coder for each step: read_file → agent turn → write_file → idx += 1
Result a working calculator on disk — no hand-written scaffold
One run = one shared dict state
planner → architect → coder · no checkpointing, so a run finishes in
tech_stack, features[] and the files[] the project needs
more tasks per file, ordered so dependencies are built first,
read the target file → prompt = task + plan's file list +
existing content → create_agent(llm, tools) writes the file →
One model drives planning, task breakdown and
writes the full file content; creates parent
returns current text, or "" when the file is new
recursively lists project files so imports stay
shell command inside the sandbox (30 s timeout)
reports the root the tools are bound to
creates generated_project/ if it is missing
resolve() + parent check → any ../ escape raises
All six tools share this single boundary
arithmetic logic, keyboard input, error handling
One run = one folder; reruns overwrite.
Front9 · Planner → Architect → Coder · LangGraph StateGraph + LangChain create_agent + Groq · every write sandboxed inside generated_project/.
